**UNRESOLVED.** Target C retains every characteristic-zero homogeneous Artinian complete intersection, every proper homogeneous quotient, and all relative graded Betti degrees. The unpaid step is the arbitrary-base transfer to the pure-power quotient; ambient Koszul bounds do not control the full Tate differentials.

The [report](/home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/openai-proof-research/frontier/campaigns/2026-10-14/fresh-structural-discovery-r10/candidate.md) records the proof attempts, two shortcut obstructions, operation-level antecedent comparison, and exact reading extents. Source reading includes `mono:transfer`, `filt:comparison`, the companion construction interface, and Murai–Peeva’s relative comparison.

Exact checks found no counterexample: 25 examples through p=4, 63 regular pencil cases through p=5, and two bar/Tate comparisons through p=2. These provide no general or asymptotic proof.

Verification passed: **61 inputs, 26 outputs, 25 pinned Git blobs**; r10 and both continuity packages remained unchanged. No nomination, independent mathematical PASS, or count change.
